60.13759,-1.28087: Scalloway Castle The castle was built in 1600 by Patrick Stewart Earl of Orkney and Lord of Shetland as his principal residence in Shetland. It consists of four storey rectangular main block with a wing of the same height at one corner. The main block contains a hall at first-floor level, reached by a spacious stair within the wing. The upper floors were divided into a series of chambers. A kitchen and other offices occupied the ground floor. Cared for by Historic Scotland

60.28635,-1.37553: AITH LIFEBOAT PIER This pier was opened by H.R.H. PRINCE OF WALES on the occasion of the naming of R.N.L.B "SNOLDA" by H.R.H PRINCESS OF WALES on 29th July 1986

This plaque has been erected in memory of Ove Joenson who was drowned at the Faroes in November 1987. Ove rowed his boat "Diana Victoria" from Torshaven to Copenhagen in 1986. On two previous attempts he was towed in by Aith life boat The John and Frances Macfarlane when he made many friends in Shetland.
